In other words, the East or West was not going to invade Yugoslavia without the intervention of the other bloc. Further, Yugoslavia was a stable nation of the Balkans containing the spread of the USSR or China influence in the region. Tito always appeared handsomely tanned fresh off a vacation in the Mediterranean. Perhaps a subtle invite meaning toward potential foreign tourists to vacation in Yugoslavia as an alternative to the coasts of France, Greece, Italy, and or Turkey. Texas had to complete prior steps before reinstatement as a US state. Texans voted on a revised state constitution in November 1869 and elected a state government. Once convened, the Texas legislature voted to ratify the 14th and 15th amendments to the U.S. Constitution (the 13th amendment having already been fully ratified) and elected its two U.S. Senators, thereby completing the requirements for reinstatement. Finally, President Grant signed into law the act to readmit Texas to Congressional representation on March 30, 1870.
